routes.notes: Transdermal patch (Daytrana). A delivery route of methylphenidate, not a separate compound. Tiers are the FDA-approved patch strengths (10/15/20/30 mg, titrated over ~9 h wear), not a recreational ladder. Deliberately no duration: patch kinetics are a prolonged-delivery system Piru declines to model, so a transdermal dose marks its time rather than drawing a curve (unmodeled-release-form policy).
